metadata.description: Read-only access to a local Windows Outlook (Classic) mailbox: as Claude Code skills (outlook) or as an MCP server (outlook-mcp). Status, search, threads, calendar, follow-ups, meeting prep, .msg/.eml files.

plugins.name: outlook
plugins.description: Read-only Outlook (Classic) skills: guided setup, search (with attachments and fuzzy reranking), thread summaries, agenda and free slots, morning brief with follow-ups, meeting prep, .msg/.eml parsing, and a local memory with settings and a reply-habit profile. Never modifies the mailbox. Pick this or outlook-mcp.

plugins.name: outlook-mcp
plugins.description: Read-only MCP server over the same Outlook (Classic) scripts: search mail (with optional reranking), threads, calendar, replies owed and awaited, meeting prep, attachments, mailbox overview, .msg/.eml parsing. For hosts that want tools instead of skills, including the Claude Desktop Chat tab. Pick this or outlook.
